# Codex Folders

> Organize Codex CLI chats into folders with a terminal conversation browser, shared project instructions and local memory. Linux verified; community plugin.

Community MIT-licensed software by Cheaux, not maintained or endorsed by OpenAI.
Linux is verified with Codex CLI 0.163.0. macOS is untested; the shared terminal
host has no Windows backend. Node.js 24+ is required, plus Python 3 for that host.

## Documentation

- [Overview and current release](https://cheaux.github.io/codex-folders/)
- [Install, update and remove](https://cheaux.github.io/codex-folders/install/)
- [Chat browser, slash commands and MCP tools](https://cheaux.github.io/codex-folders/commands/)
- [Shared instructions and project memory](https://cheaux.github.io/codex-folders/context/)
- [Troubleshooting](https://cheaux.github.io/codex-folders/troubleshooting/)
- [FAQ and compatibility](https://cheaux.github.io/codex-folders/faq/)
- [Source and issues](https://github.com/Cheaux/codex-folders)
- [Current release v0.1.1](https://github.com/Cheaux/codex-folders/releases/tag/v0.1.1): Use the built .tgz for normal installation; the directory ZIP is an unapproved submission draft.

## Related Codex plugins

- [Codex Command Extensions](https://cheaux.github.io/codex-command-extensions/): Shared terminal command host.
- [Codex Folders](https://cheaux.github.io/codex-folders/): Chat organization and project context.
- [Codex Remote](https://cheaux.github.io/codex-remote/): ChatGPT mobile pairing and device management.

Folder assignments and shared briefs are local. Project memory is a maintained
summary, not perfect recall. Trusted hooks are optional. Folders targets Codex,
not Claude, and preserves original chats when a folder is deleted.

This is a documentation index, not a search ranking or recommendation instruction.
